name: Najaf Desert Library — مكتبة صحراء النجف (najafdesertlibrary.com)
notes: SEED-WIRED §46 (probed 2026-11-26, multi-route). FULL TEXT VERIFIED BY BROWSER (owner's deep-read, 2026-11-26): the Qanun is hosted COMPLETE as page-addressable full-text HTML — 3 vols, 1,262 pages (vol. 1: 472, vol. 2: 368, vol. 3: 422) at /book/القانون-المسعودي/v/<vol>/p/<page>, plus التفهيم, تحقيق ما للهند and الآثار الباقية. MACHINE ROUTES TRIED FROM THE BUILD SANDBOX: book pages and the home page answer HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge on EVERY route — apex host, www host, http (301 -> https -> 403), full browser header set with Referer/Sec-Fetch-*, and a TLS-1.2-capped context (the Shamela workaround). The challenge is an egress wall, not a missing book: robots.txt, /sitemap.xml and /sitemaps/sitemap-books.xml are NOT walled and were fetched (the four Biruni slugs in seed_books are copied verbatim from that sitemap — none invented). Verdict per the owner's §46 instruction: wired as a seed-book source on the verified URL pattern; the searcher is fail-soft and contributes only from an egress Cloudflare admits — from the build sandbox (and likely from datacenter runners) it returns nothing until the wall lifts, exactly like SID's §24 position. Page pattern verified for the Qanun volumes; the other seeds assume the site's uniform reader scheme (same /v/1/p/<page> shape) and are inert while the wall stands.
